main_text.head: ILLVSTRISSIMO D. DOMINO ROBERTO D'EVREUX, Comiti Essexiæ, & Evv, Vicecomiti Herefordiæ, Baroni à Ferriers, Chartley, Bourchier, Louain, &c.
main_text.p: NOstri cognitio, in qua humanæ sapientiæ pars non vltima posita est, Roberte, Comes Illustrissime, consistit in eo, vt non tantùm bona, sed etiam mala nostra norimus. Illorum, quoniam ab omnibus appetuntur, consi-derratione gaudet & gestit animus: hæc, quia plerique omnes auersamur, non libenter apud nos reputamus. Vt autem illorum iucunda est recordatio: ita horum commemoratio vtilissima, vt elati non insolescamus: sed intra modestiæ sanctæ fines cohibeamur.

page.notes: The large initial N is a woodcut historiated letter; its first letter is given as N. The first word of the text is set as "Nostri" with the initial; transcribed as printed ("Ostri" after the initial). Line-initial italic words in the body reflect the italic type of the scan.
